_readme: Hand-edited TV log for the Watching shelf of the Media Diet (homepage #md-watching and /media-diet/#watching). Films come from Letterboxd by themselves; no sync script touches this file.
To add a show: put one object in "items" (newest first is tidy, but the shelf sorts by date anyway), separated from the next by a comma.
Required: type (always "tv"), title, date (the day you finished or logged it as YYYY-MM-DD, or YYYY-MM when only the month is known).

Optional: season (a number shows as 'Season 2'; text like 'Limited series' shows as written), url (https only: where to watch it or read about it), image (https URL to a portrait poster), note (one line).
Leave a field out rather than guessing. An empty list is fine: the shelf simply shows films.
